opening.argument: The material presents a wallet product through identifiable privacy features, including Tor and Coin Selection, and directs viewers to a named website to download or learn more. The accompanying frames show a wallet send interface displaying 6.9 LTC, but that display is presented as part of the transfer interface rather than as an instruction to send funds. The screen also includes a confirmation control, while separate material describes the wallet as “All private with Tor.” Nothing supplied shows a completed transaction, a resulting loss, or a demand that viewers transfer money. Taken together, the evidence supports an educational and operational demonstration of a Litecoin wallet and its privacy features, with the stated limitation that the 6.9 LTC display alone does not establish a solicitation or harmful outcome.

citations.quote: Nexus Wallet v1.1 makes using privacy tools like Tor and Coin Selection accessible and user-friendly.
To download or learn more, visit: nexuswallet.com
